newsitem.title: USA: 1st United Bancorp buys Seaboard Savings.
newsitem.headline: 1st United Bancorp buys Seaboard Savings.

text.p: 1st United Bancorp said Tuesday that it has definitively agreed to acquire Seaboard Savings Bank, a bank in Stuart, Florida, with assets of about $75 million.
Bancorp said it will pay about $8.25 million to acquire Seaboard, paying 50 percent in cash and 50 percent in its common stock.
It said it expects the deal to be accretive to earnings and to close in the third quarter, subject to regulatory approval and the approval of Seaboard shareholders.

1st United Bancorp has assets of about $680 million, deposits of $615 million and shareholders' equity of $62 million. 1st United Bank has 32 banking centers in Palm Beach, Brevard, Broward and Martin Counties.
